title: VISPA: Pluralistic Alignment via Automatic Value Selection and Activation
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'pluralistic alignment,' which aims to steer Large Language Models to reflect a diverse range of human values. It specifically incorporates and evaluates models against taxonomies of moral theories (such as deontology, utilitarianism, and virtue ethics) and spiritual/cultural constructs (such as karma, honor, and spirituality), using benchmarks like VITAL to measure alignment with these ethical perspectives.
